defects.defect: The whole design rests on the documented-behavior assumption that roll-up recalculation from a Review__c save runs the record-triggered flows on Storefront__c. The eval notes disagree and expect the trigger on Review__c or a scheduled job. The assumption is labelled, and the Apex DML tests would catch a failure, but the spec gives no fallback if the parent flow does not fire.
defects.skill_gap: None. design-rules has no rule on where to place automation driven by roll-up or formula values (the run's skill_friction proposes one).
